rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for one's mother's husband after her first marriage or relationship.

example.english: My stepfather often picked me up from school when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣，後父成日接我放學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hau6 fu6 seng4 jat6 zip3 ngo5 fong3 hok6

rows.note: Use this more formal term, especially in writing or official contexts, for the same family relationship.

example.english: The application form must include the stepfather's name.
example.traditional: 申請表上必須填寫繼父嘅姓名。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 biu2 soeng6 bit1 seoi1 tin4 se2 gai3 fu6 ge3 sing3 ming4
